claim_scope: conditional on the declared N: a certify/16e ID or IDF means unique among machines with at most N states (family_bound) consistent with the noise-free trace; a certify/16n ID or IDF additionally assumes every majority is correct, which holds with probability >= 1 - delta per record under iid flips with eps <= eps_bar. Inferred reason: a larger machine can copy the true machine on every visited state and differ only elsewhere, so no finite test separates them
